title: Use
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
e Purchase contracts for small power producers, solar installations, and other forms of energy feeding.

e Plant consumption contracts for generation and distribution installations of the utilities company.

e Company consumption contracts, for example for the electricity consumption of offices at the utilities company

1 Note

Service contracts (for example, for maintenance and repair) are not managed in this component; the Customer Service
(CS) component is used instead. Service contracts are billed in the Sales and Distribution (SD) component.

Use

A contract is related to a division. It links one single contract account to one installation (see graphic for the master data (ISU-BF)
component). However, it is possible for several contracts to be grouped together in one contract account.

A contract contains control data for Aontract Billing and Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable. These are:

e General data (for example, contract account)

e Move-in and move-out data

e Schedule data (for example, start date and cancellation date)

e Billing-relevant data

e Account assignment data (for example, account determination ID)
e Sales and distribution data

e Deregulation data (for example service providers)

e Data relevant to budget billing

Contract model: Where Does Data Originate
